verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents Stencil, a Handlebars-based theme engine for hosted storefronts (docs-6/24, docs-15), and a hands-on user praises running the site locally against live product data (comm-1), which covers templating and local preview. Another developer calls the templating tag system incomplete and inconsistent (comm-6); that is a quality complaint, not proof the capability is absent. Nothing in the evidence shows version-controlled or CLI-based theme deploys. Missing for 10: evidence of version-controlled/CLI theme deploy workflow, detailed first-party docs on local preview tooling, corroboration that templating is complete and consistent.
